hook.line: 'Tiktok affiliate tips' title over a trending song line, 'give me something I can feel'.
hook.visual: Handheld phone shot of a dusk sky with a street lamp; a stack of white text: italic title, sparkle-framed 'search engine optimization', then two Tagalog paragraphs.

beats.what: Full text card is on screen from frame one: title, SEO tip, personal proof, comment prompt
Trending sound starts with its one sung line
Camera drifts down to street lamps and power lines; text stays fixed
A car's side mirror enters the bottom of the frame, showing it was filmed from a car
Clip ends on the same sky and loops back

why_it_works: All the value is in text that takes longer than 15 s to read, so viewers rewatch or pause
The on-screen line 'comment if you still don't know how' asks for comments on the first frame; 6,624 comments followed
A calm sky clip and a trending sound make it feel like a friend's post, not an ad
Personal proof (under 50 posts yet viral videos thanks to SEO) makes the tip feel attainable
weaknesses: No actual how-to on screen; the tip is a teaser that only works as comment bait
Paragraph text in a small font sits outside the safe area the whole time
No face, no voice, nothing to recognise the creator by
for_robert: Avoid the wall of paragraph text; borrow only the comment prompt on frame one, phrased as a question his audience can answer in one word.
